goal: Find sequence-to-reporter-expression candidate patterns that survive guarded evaluation, baseline comparisons, source forensics and independent numerical implementation; retain negative results.
inference_status: Retrospective exploratory public-data analysis, not preregistered confirmatory inference or an untouched HBB holdout.

outcome_exposure.HBB: Previously explored; historical outcomes and sample rows already known. No claim of pristine validation.
outcome_exposure.new_cohort: Selected on metadata, endpoint, license, species, sequence/reference identity and role before score retrieval; no threshold/model selection from outcomes.

inputs.required_hashes: Validate all dataset and motif manifest commitments before parsing outcomes; report each input manifest SHA256 and protocol SHA256.

cohort.data_license: CC0 1.0 per-score-set data grant verified, producer attribution retained
cohort.selection: All nine eligible unique non-HBB promoter loci; among same-element records choose lexicographically first fullURN as primary; keep specified other records validation-only. No score-based inclusion.
cohort.same_study_limit: Distinct loci/cell contexts share a study, source processing and sometimes constructed libraries. They are not independent studies or a random sample of human promoters.

row_inclusion.variant_type: Unambiguous single-nucleotide substitution n.POSREF>ALT with positive one-based target coordinate, REF and ALT in ACGT, REF!=ALT.
row_inclusion.grouping: Retain every quality-passing SNV; one to three eligible alleles per position are allowed. All retained alleles at a position share folds and bootstrap blocks. Report incomplete positions and per-position allele counts; never discard a valid allele solely because another is missing.
row_inclusion.equality_and_deletion_rows: Exclude from fitting and all prediction metrics; preserve raw rows and source-forensics crosswalk separately.
row_inclusion.pvalues: Never a predictor feature or outcome-dependent inclusion threshold.
row_inclusion.duplicates: Reject duplicate accession or SNV representation; never treat technical/library/context records as different loci.
row_inclusion.missingness: No silent imputations; disclose every raw row and whole-position exclusion before metric aggregation.

features.orientation: Use provided source target orientation consistently; no gene-strand inference from labels. All motif scans use both strands.
features.external_flanks: Do not use outside-target sequence; only windows fully contained in the provided target. Edge support truncation is fixed and disclosed.
features.mutation_encoding: One-hot twelve directed reference-to-alternate identities, in the explicit order.
features.delta3mer: For each 3mer window fully inside target and containing the changed base, count ALT 3mers minus REF 3mers across the same windows. 64 signed integer features, not normalized by available-window count; maximum radius2.
features.motif_features: Four signed deltas only, in motif_ids order. Ref/alt maxima may be reported but are not predictor covariates.

motif_scoring.scan: All fully contained motif windows overlapping changed base, on both strands; max_ref and max_alt use the identical window/orientation candidate set. delta=max_alt-max_ref.
motif_scoring.taxonomy_limit: GATA1/KLF1/NFYA human metadata; TBP source taxonomy missing, retained as a documented prior-motif limitation.

prohibited: assay or cell ID as learned covariate

fit.algorithm: Ridge ordinary squared-error regression; mean model is training ymean only.
fit.objective: sum_i((y_i-intercept-Xstd_i beta)^2)+alpha*sum_j(beta_j^2), without division by n
fit.intercept: Unpenalized; center training y by its unweighted row mean and predict ymean+Xstd beta.
fit.feature_scaling: For each fitted fold, training-only feature mean and population SD (ddof0). If SD<=1e-12 use scale1. Apply those same means/scales to test.
fit.y_scaling: No outcome scaling; preserve raw log2 effect units.
fit.sample_weight: Equal retained training rows, no assay-specific weighting or test intercept.
fit.selection: No alpha/model/feature/window selection, nested optimization or threshold tuning in v1.
fit.linear_solve: Solve (Xstd^T Xstd+alpha I) beta=Xstd^T(y-ymean); f64 arithmetic.

hbb_guarded_position_cv.role: Exploratory within-element assessment on already explored HBB
hbb_guarded_position_cv.fold_boundaries_zero_based: boundary[k]=floor(k*target_length/5), k=0..5; test position p has boundary[k]<=p-1<boundary[k+1].
hbb_guarded_position_cv.training_rule: Keep a training center only if its distance from every test center is strictly greater than20. All included alleles at each position share a fold.
hbb_guarded_position_cv.leakage_contract: radius10 feature supports are disjoint across train/test at distance>20; biochemical/source dependence can remain.

primary_leave_element_out.role: Primary retrospective cross-element assessment of nine newly acquired promoter loci
primary_leave_element_out.training_assays: All other primary-role loci only. Never include HBB or validation-only records.
primary_leave_element_out.aggregation: Per-target-position mean errors, then per-assay mean; macro-average across nine test assays. Report each assay and cell context separately.

hbb_to_external_transfer.test_assays: All nine primary-role loci, with frozen training preprocessing and no test normalization.

row_random_diagnostic.role: Explicitly leaky diagnostic, never primary or model selection
row_random_diagnostic.assignment: SHA256(assay_id+"|"+position_1based+"|"+REF+">"+ALT+"|row-random-v1"); first8 digest bytes interpreted little-endian unsigned mod5.
row_random_diagnostic.report: Report number of test positions also represented in training and feature-window overlap. Gap versus guarded CV also reflects different split difficulty; do not attribute it solely to leakage.

metrics.primary_error: MSE in squared log2-effect units; average allele errors per position, then positions within assay, then macro over primary assays.
secondary: Spearman rho over all retained SNV rows per heldout assay using average ranks for exact ties
Spearman rho of per-position mean prediction versus per-position mean observed effect
per-assay relative MSE versus training-mean baseline; undefined if baseline MSE=0
metrics.constant_rank_rule: Return null, not zero, when either ranked vector has zero variance; disclose unavailable rank metrics.

prng.step: state=(state+0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)mod2^64; z=(state xor(state>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9 mod2^64; z=(z xor(z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB mod2^64; output=z xor(z>>31); bounded index=output mod n.

resampling.quantiles: Type7 linear interpolation at0.025 and0.975 on sorted resampled statistics.

hbb_position_block_bootstrap.blocks: Nonoverlapping included-position blocks anchored at physical positions1,22,43,...; keep last shorter block, exclude empty blocks. Draw number_of_nonempty_blocks blocks with replacement and concatenate all rows of each selected block.
hbb_position_block_bootstrap.unit: Frozen OOF per-position paired loss differences; no refitting.
hbb_position_block_bootstrap.statistic: Baseline MSE minus candidate MSE over resampled positions for each comparison.

external_element_bootstrap.unit: Draw nine primary assay indices with replacement; equal-element mean of frozen leave-element-out paired per-assay MSE differences.
external_element_bootstrap.statistic: Macro baseline MSE minus candidate MSE for each comparison.

resampling.interpretation: Descriptive conditional resampling of fixed OOF prediction losses; nine selected elements share one study and OOF fits overlap. Not guaranteed population confidence intervals or full model-selection uncertainty.

spatial_null.scope: Guarded HBB comparison and primary leave-element-out comparison only.
spatial_null.transform: For each replicate, process assays in lexicographic fullURN order, then mutation_identity_order. Within each assay+directed REF>ALT class, order retained rows by one-based target position and accession; rotate scores circularly by offset=1+SplitMix64%(stratum_size-1). The score assigned to destination row i is original score[(i+offset)%stratum_size]. Strata with fewer than2 rows stay unchanged and are reported. Every included row remains included; no scores are assigned to a different chemistry class. Keep features/eligibility/folds fixed.
spatial_null.preserved: Per-assay directed mutation-chemistry score distributions and cyclic positional ordering within each class. This breaks cross-class/within-position outcome correlation and does not preserve absolute genomic gaps or all library dependence; disclose these limits.
spatial_null.refit: Refit every model on rotated training outcomes using the fixed training-only X scaling; recompute rotated training ymean and RHS and evaluate rotated test outcomes. Cache each fold/model Gram matrix and factorization because X is unchanged. No feature/window/model changes or reuse of real ymeans.
spatial_null.statistic: Baseline MSE minus candidate MSE (same aggregation as real evaluation); larger is better.
spatial_null.adjustment: Holm step-down across the three prespecified comparisons within each of two evaluation families separately; disclose both families (6 total planned tails). Also report conservative Bonferroni over all6 planned tails.
spatial_null.interpretation: Falsification/robustness control under chemistry-stratified spatial stationarity and an artificial rotation transformation, not a calibrated biological-significance p-value. No discovery declaration from a threshold.

validation_context_analysis.training: Never train on validation-only score sets.
validation_context_analysis.matching: Match exact reference-validated genomic SNV identity; report per-pair overlap and exclusions. No equality/deletion rows.
metrics: MSE and MAE of matched coefficients
validation_context_analysis.lower_bound_scope: Finite observed-source algebraic bound for any predictor assigning the same value to an identical variant across these contexts. It does not assign causes to variance, establish noise-free biology or generalize beyond observed contexts. Compare LDLR library-repeat differences with cell/time/perturbation contexts without treating any as independent loci.

must_match: per-record OOF predictions and model metrics
replication.mismatch_policy: Investigate and resolve differences before claiming reproduction; never silently loosen tolerances.
replication.artifact_policy: New output directory only; retain complete predictions, coefficients/scaling, diagnostics, null statistics, resample summaries, source/protocol hashes and failures.

stopping_and_claims.negative_results: Report failed controls, uncertainty and source anomalies as results; do not search additional models in v1 until something appears.
stopping_and_claims.candidate_mechanism: A robust sequence association is a candidate for an independent perturbation experiment, not a proven mechanism.
stopping_and_claims.novelty: Check prior literature before calling a pattern novel. A computational rediscovery or source-curation correction must be labeled accordingly.
stopping_and_claims.independent_validation_gap: One study across promoters and cell contexts is not independent laboratory replication or a model of the entire human genome.

freeze_note: Initial draft was amended before any new score acquisition or any real-data fitting to retain incomplete positions and use chemistry-stratified rotations. This final hash is the implementation/acquisition authority.
